title: Gate the fleet fake backend behind test-support

truths: fleet declares a test-support feature with no default
backend.rs declares pub mod fake under cfg(any(test, feature = test-support))
fleet and bee enable test-support only through dev-dependencies
cargo test -p fleet passes including tests/choreography.rs

action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1.
